scope: Real-valued time and real amounts against the Becoming core's discrete steps and whole amounts: a course whose levels change at the rate given less taken, its rates summable, balances over every stretch and so across every step of any reading at instants, coarser steps summing the finer, while a balanced course read at the whole instants can stand still at every step and change between them; no reading into the whole numbers keeps the order of an endless fall, real amounts fall so, and multiples of a unit are read in whole numbers; a halving level is new at every step without gain, while finitely many conditions new by at least a least separation exceed every bound; a held loop of any positive real strength carries D (1 + r) ^ count, the core's self-loop its case, and is bounded by a polynomial exactly where two to the count is, while a damped loop coupling at every step stays bounded exactly where its factor and strength add to at most one; for the step of a web of conditions in any normed ring, what it carries vanishes exactly where its rate, the least norm of a power to the inverse of the power, is below one and runs away where above one, one condition's rate being the absolute value of factor plus strength; a held web coupling at some steps carries (1 + S) ^ count and, where the rate of 1 + S is above one, is bounded by a polynomial exactly where two to the count is. That an actual becoming's rates, amounts and loops are of these forms is a correspondence, not checked.
